items.hyp: Tonakgolo ya Dipatlisiso tsa Setšhaba le Tshireletso (COGTA), Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a tlhagelela kwa mmusinngwe wa kwa ntle ga Mbizana kwa Winnie Madikizela Mandela Local Municipality.
items.ref: Tona ya Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), Ngk Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a tsenetse moletlo o wa semmuso wa go fetola leina la Mbizana go nna Mmasepala wa selegae wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

items.hyp: Mmueledi wa mmasepala wa e ne e leng Winnie Madikizela-Mandela Municipality, Daniswa Mafumbatha, a re diprogramo di ne di lebala go etela gore batho ba lefatshe ba tshwanetse go nna le tshegetso ya mabapi le mabapi.
items.ref: Mmeyara wa Masepala o montšha o o tswang go kaiwa ka leina le le ntšha la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa  Mafumbatha o rile, go na le mananeo a rulagantsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba lefelo le ba ungwa sengwe  go tswa mo segakeng sa tokologo.

items.hyp: Mafumbatha a re fa go tlhoka mafapha a go tlhoka mafapha a go tshwana go tswelela meento.
items.ref: Mafumbatha o dumela gore go fetola leina la mmasepala go tla ngokela babeeletsi go feta.

items.hyp: Winnie Madikizela Mandela o ne a ikola ikonomi ya mafelo a go tswa mo mafelong a a tshwanang go tswa mo mafelong a a tshwanang.
items.ref: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela o ne a le mogaka wa boditšhabatšhaba jaanong go reela mmasepala ka leina la gagwe go tlile go dira gore tlhabololo ya rona e gole ka bonako, mme gape re bua ka boswa jwa Mme Winnie.

items.hyp: Batho ba tlaa tshwara go bona lekhubu le go nna le dipagamaneng.
items.ref: Batho ba tla goroga go bona sefikantswe,  e bile go na le mananeo a a ka rulagantsweng teng.

items.hyp: Mosekaseki wa ditshwaetso tsa bosenyi mo kgatlasing ya Frere kwa Kapa Bophirima, Dr David Stead, o tlhageletse gore tshepo ya go tsenngwa mo kgatong ya boima e e tshwanang le tshepo ya leroborobo la leroborobo la boima la leroborobobo la coronavirus la go tsenngwa mo dingwageng di le mmalwa tse di fetileng.
items.ref: Moitseanape wa malwetse a a tshelanang kwa Bookelong jwa Frere kwa Kapa Botlhaba, Ngk David Stead,  o tlhagisitse matshwenyego a gore tsweletso ya go nwa notagi kwa mafelong ka nako ya maikhutso a paseka a beke e telele a ka oketsa  ditshwaetso  tsa Khorona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.

items.hyp: Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa mo bekeng e, o begile gore go tsaya molao wa dipeko tsa go nna le madi a a farologaneng go tswa mo Lamatlhatso go tswa mo Mosupologo, mme dipeko di tlaa tshwara go tsaya mo molaweng wa dinako, wotlhe le wotlhe.
